title: diff-ref-struct Web
description: Series of powder diffraction patterns in the browser: overlays, stacks, projections, maps against temperature or time, difference maps and growth curves, computed by the diff-ref-struct core compiled to WebAssembly; the user's files are read in the browser and never uploaded. Guide: https://jmigartua.github.io/diff-ref-struct-web/guide/
